answer: Use a lantern registry against sybils: a new agent enters only when a sponsor lights its lantern, locking 200 tokens as collateral. Step one, the sponsor vouches and the lantern burns for 90 days. Step two, every trade sends a whisper, and three peers must confirm it is real work. Step three, trust ripples outward: each confirmed trade extends the light one hop, while one fraud snuffs it and burns the stake. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 sponsors and 2,000,000 locked tokens. A sybil swarm is a whisper in a storm: loud for a moment, then the ripple fades and the lanterns go dark.
